There is no other calc name in the dict resembling a direct-damage formula. Correctly left with no P block -- the passive itself deals zero direct damage; its entire effect is stat-buff, which the schema has no hit-shape for.
_noteQ: Q investigated this session. CharacterRecord.spellNames[0] (the object ChampionBinParser maps to Skills["Q"]) is 'ApheliosQ_ClientTooltipWrapper', NOT any of the 5 real per-weapon Q spell objects (Calibrum/Severum/Gravitum/Infernum/Crescendum, found at separate hashed keys like {9501e989}/{c872c72d}/{b3ce4169}/{d29e7023}/{ad4cfba9} with real SpellCalculations e.g. Calibrum's 'SpellDamage'+'BonusDamagePerMark', Severum's 'TotalDamage', Gravitum's 'Damage', Infernum's 'QWaveDamage', Crescendum's 'MiniDamageMin/Max'). The wrapper's own mSpell has an EMPTY mSpellCalculations dict (confirmed: zero entries, only cast/range/mana/tooltip-format fields) -- it exists purely to show whichever weapon's tooltip text is currently equipped, and carries no formula of its own. Since SkillDamage.ComputeCalcDamage looks up the named calc inside THIS slot's SkillData.SpellCalculations only, no calc name from any of the 5 weapon objects would ever resolve here (KeyNotFoundException every time) -- this is a structural gap in how a multi-weapon champion maps onto the single Q/W/E ability-slot model this codebase uses, not an unsupported CalculationPart kind or a missing cross-reference. Genuinely left with no Q hits (auto flag kept, not force-fed a wrong weapon's number).

_noteQSeverum_floor: GOLDEN #15 RESOLVED (2026-07-26, final corrected reading: 7 hits x 15 dealt at 36.3% bonus AS): the live per-hit EXACTLY matches the standalone per-hit calc {9480e64f} (0.20+0.035x2 breakpoints at L6 = 0.27xAD = 22.95 raw = 15.3 dealt, log-displayed 15), and the hit count = StartingAttacks 6 + 1 AS-granted extra.
